name: Default
shortDescription: Stateless authorization policy decision point that evaluates YAML access policies over an HTTP API, with a built-in API explorer.

alerts.message: The Cerbos API has no authentication of its own: anyone who knows the URL can query authorization decisions. Replace the example policy with your own policies before connecting applications.
Only the HTTP API is routed to the domain; the gRPC API on port 3593 is not. Use an SDK's HTTP client, since gRPC-only SDKs cannot connect through the domain.
